a.lede: Microsoft's day-long outage began with Outlook and Teams, and ended up taking much of the company's cloud services offline. Microsoft says it's gradually restoring service.
a.title: Microsoft’s latest email outage turned into a full blown global cloud crisis

b.title: Massive Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot worldwide
